# Template provenance

The PR, bug-report, and feature-request templates are adapted from
[akitaonrails/ai-memory at 958fb4b0f36af5e555c8803b727474c6f38a2a20](https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/tree/958fb4b0f36af5e555c8803b727474c6f38a2a20/.github).
Their original MIT notice is retained in [TEMPLATE_LICENSE](TEMPLATE_LICENSE).

Section structure and review gates are preserved. Project names, transport names,
commands, attribution links, and schema terminology refer to lazysh. Unlike the
upstream standing release-branch rule, every lazysh branch starts from `main` and
every PR targets `main`, as required by the project owner.
